entries.en: An occupational therapist assessed how acrocontracture affected his daily routine.
entries.zh: 一位作业治疗师评估了肢挛缩对他日常生活的影响。

entries.en: The clinic scheduled a follow-up appointment for his acrodermatitis.
entries.zh: 诊所为他的肢皮炎安排了一次复诊。

entries.en: The insurer requested further details about her acrodermatosis before reviewing the claim.
entries.zh: 保险公司要求进一步了解她的肢皮病，再审核理赔申请。

entries.en: At the follow-up visit, the doctor photographed the acroerythema for comparison.
entries.zh: 复诊时，医生拍下了肢端红斑的照片，以便比较。

entries.en: He asked for a copy of the specialist's findings on his acrokeratosis.
entries.zh: 他索要了一份专科医生关于其肢端角化症的检查结果副本。

entries.en: At formal interviews, she shifts towards the acrolect used by local broadcasters.
entries.zh: 在正式面试时，她会转用当地播音员所用的上层方言。

entries.en: The conservators moved the acrolith only after securing its wooden torso.
entries.zh: 保护人员在固定好木制躯干后，才搬动了那尊石首石肢木身雕像。

entries.en: The hospital arranged a second opinion on her acroosteolysis.
entries.zh: 医院安排了另一位医生就她的肢端骨质溶解提供诊疗意见。

entries.en: As an acrophobe, he chose a seat well away from the observation deck's glass edge.
entries.zh: 作为一名恐高症患者，他选了一个远离观景台玻璃边缘的座位。

entries.en: The survey recorded three species of Acropora in this area.
entries.zh: 那次调查在这一带记录了鹿角珊瑚属的三个物种。

entries.en: We measured the acrospire of each germinating barley grain with a ruler.
entries.zh: 我们用尺子测量了每粒萌发大麦种子的旋状幼芽。

entries.meaningZh: 建筑物顶部雕像底座〔希腊语源，复数〕
entries.en: Two acroteria remained on the roof after the statues had been removed.
entries.zh: 雕像被移走后，屋顶上还留着两座雕像底座。

entries.en: A crack in the acroterion delayed the return of the statue to the pediment.
entries.zh: 雕像台座上的一道裂缝，使雕像未能按时放回山花上。

entries.en: The fallen acroterium lay in fragments beside the entrance.
entries.zh: 那件掉落的基座装饰物碎成几块，散落在入口旁。

entries.en: An error in the invoice delayed the delivery of acrylaldehyde to the laboratory.
entries.zh: 发票上的一个错误导致送往实验室的丙烯醛延误。

entries.en: Acta left the spare keys with a neighbour before leaving for the weekend.
entries.zh: 阿克塔出门度周末前，把备用钥匙交给了一位邻居保管。

entries.en: The student underlined the actant but overlooked the verb that governed it.
entries.zh: 那个学生在主价语下面画了线，却漏看了支配它的动词。

entries.en: She fastened the actigraph to her wrist before the study began.
entries.zh: 研究开始前，她把活动变化记录仪固定在手腕上。

entries.en: Several actiniae were visible in the shallow pool beside the rocks.
entries.zh: 岩石旁的浅水池里可以看见几只海葵。

entries.en: Their next experiment required actinidine, which the laboratory did not have.
entries.zh: 他们的下一项实验需要猕猴桃碱，但实验室里没有。

entries.en: Her dissertation on actinochemistry attracted readers from both chemistry and physics.
entries.zh: 她的光化学学位论文吸引了化学和物理学两个领域的读者。

entries.en: The fieldwork in actinography required a record of every instrument adjustment.
entries.zh: 那项光量测定实地工作要求记录每一次仪器调整。

entries.en: The university library moved its books on actinology to the history of science collection.
entries.zh: 大学图书馆把光化学方面的那些书移到了科学史馆藏区。

entries.en: The damaged petal made the flower's actinomorphy harder to recognise.
entries.zh: 受损的花瓣使这朵花的辐射对称特征更难辨认。

entries.en: The researchers compared the actinophage with two isolates from an earlier study.
entries.zh: 研究人员把那种放线菌噬体与先前研究中的两个分离株作了比较。

entries.en: The museum devoted an entire gallery to the diversity of Actinopterygii.
entries.zh: 博物馆用整整一个展厅介绍辐鳍鱼纲的多样性。

entries.en: A student sketched the actinotrocha while another adjusted the microscope's focus.
entries.zh: 一名学生描画那只辐轮幼虫时，另一名学生在调整显微镜的焦距。

entries.en: We could see only part of the actinula through the debris.
entries.zh: 透过那些碎屑，我们只能看见那只辐射幼虫的一部分。

entries.en: Her essay traced an actio through an imagined dispute in ancient Rome.
entries.zh: 她的论文以一场虚构的古罗马纠纷为背景，梳理了一宗诉讼的过程。

entries.en: The lawyers disagreed about the actionability of the statement.
entries.zh: 那些律师对那番话是否可成为起诉依据意见不一。

entries.en: We watched a noisy actioner because nobody felt like following a complicated plot.
entries.zh: 我们看了一部闹腾的动作片，因为谁都不想费神琢磨复杂的情节。

entries.en: The actionist urged the committee to begin work instead of ordering another study.
entries.zh: 那位行动主义者敦促委员会着手工作，而不是再安排一项研究。

entries.en: Actis found a handwritten recipe tucked inside the second-hand cookbook.
entries.zh: 阿克蒂发现那本二手烹饪书里夹着一份手写食谱。

entries.en: The team discussed removing ActiveX from the old application during its redesign.
entries.zh: 团队在重新设计那个旧应用程序时，讨论了移除 ActiveX 技术的问题。

entries.en: She applied for an internship at Activision after finishing her portfolio.
entries.zh: 她完成作品集后，向动视申请了一个实习职位。

entries.en: The school borrowed an ACTO projector for the evening performance.
entries.zh: 学校为晚上的演出借了一台雅图投影机。

entries.en: After the power cut, the actograph stopped recording.
entries.zh: 停电后，活动变化记录仪停止了记录。

entries.en: The museum displayed an old acumeter beside several early hearing aids.
entries.zh: 博物馆把一台旧听力计陈列在几件早期助听器旁边。

entries.en: A small chip had broken off the acumination at the top of the ornament.
entries.zh: 装饰物顶端的尖头崩掉了一小块。

entries.en: Acuna put the heavier parcel on the floor and rang the bell.
entries.zh: 阿库纳把较重的那个包裹放在地上，然后按了门铃。

entries.en: The students compared the acupoint on the teaching model with the printed diagram.
entries.zh: 学生们把教学模型上的那个穴位与印刷示意图作了对照。

entries.en: The library received a collection of books on acupuncturology from a retired lecturer.
entries.zh: 图书馆从一位退休讲师那里收到了一批针灸学书籍。

entries.en: I left my umbrella on the back seat of her Acura.
entries.zh: 我把雨伞落在她那辆讴歌车的后座上了。

entries.meaningZh: 爱人〔爱尔兰英语亲昵称呼〕
entries.en: "Come and sit beside me, acushla," he said, reaching for his wife's hand.
entries.zh: “过来坐在我身边吧，亲爱的。”他说着，伸手去握妻子的手。

entries.en: The photographer measured the acutance of both prints before choosing one for the exhibition.
entries.zh: 摄影师测量了两张照片的锐度，才选其中一张用于展览。

entries.en: We postponed the comparison until the supplier could provide more acutumine.
entries.zh: 我们推迟了那项比较，等供应商提供更多尖防己碱后再做。

entries.en: Acworth offered to carry the folded chairs back to the storeroom.
entries.zh: 阿克沃思主动提出把那些折叠椅搬回储藏室。

entries.en: The program checks the graph's acyclicity before attempting a topological sort.
entries.zh: 程序在尝试拓扑排序之前，会检查图的无环性。

entries.en: The isolated product was an acylal, not the aldehyde we had expected.
entries.zh: 分离出的产物是一种缩羰酯，而不是我们预期的醛。

entries.en: The student's drawing of the acylamide omitted a bond beside the nitrogen atom.
entries.zh: 那个学生画的酰胺结构图漏掉了氮原子旁的一根键。

entries.en: The revised mechanism includes an acylcarbene as a possible intermediate.
entries.zh: 修订后的反应机理把一种酰基碳烯列为可能的中间体。

entries.en: The ad-man rewrote the slogan after hearing how customers pronounced the product's name.
entries.zh: 那位广告撰写员听到顾客怎样读产品名称后，重写了广告语。

entries.en: The geologist packed the adakite separately so it would not damage the smaller specimens.
entries.zh: 地质学家把那块埃达克岩单独装好，以免它损坏较小的标本。

entries.en: Adalberto noticed a loose screw while assembling the new desk.
entries.zh: 阿达尔贝托组装新书桌时，注意到一颗螺丝松了。

entries.en: Adalet moved the plant away from the door to make room for the pram.
entries.zh: 阿达莱特把那盆植物从门边移开，给婴儿车腾出空间。

entries.en: We stayed in Adama for one night before continuing our journey.
entries.zh: 我们在阿达玛住了一晚，才继续赶路。

entries.en: Her adamancy about keeping the library open surprised the council.
entries.zh: 她坚持让图书馆继续开放的坚定态度，使议会感到惊讶。

entries.en: The requisition for adamantanamine was returned because the quantity had not been specified.
entries.zh: 那张三环癸烷胺申购单因未注明数量而被退回。

entries.en: The student enlarged the image to examine a single adamantoblast.
entries.zh: 那个学生放大图像，观察一个成釉细胞。

entries.en: Adamczyk replaced the missing button with one from an old coat.
entries.zh: 亚当奇克从一件旧外套上找了颗纽扣，补上了缺失的那颗。

entries.en: Adame asked us to keep the receipt in case the lamp had to be returned.
entries.zh: 阿达梅让我们留着收据，以防那盏灯需要退货。

entries.en: Adami pulled up another chair when an unexpected guest arrived.
entries.zh: 一位意料之外的客人到来时，阿达米又拉过来一把椅子。

entries.en: Ms Adamo returned the repaired violin in a padded case.
entries.zh: 阿达莫女士用一个有软垫的琴盒装着修好的小提琴，把它还了回来。

entries.en: Adamov wrote the shopping list on the back of an envelope.
entries.zh: 阿达莫夫把购物清单写在了一个信封的背面。

entries.en: Adamski left a note explaining which cupboard held the spare blankets.
entries.zh: 亚当斯基留了张便条，说明备用毯子放在哪个柜子里。

entries.en: Adamu took a different route home to avoid the roadworks.
entries.zh: 阿达穆回家时换了一条路线，以避开道路施工。

entries.en: Adan carefully wrapped the broken handle before putting it in the drawer.
entries.zh: 阿丹把那个断掉的把手仔细包好，才放进抽屉里。

entries.en: The botanist compared two species of Adansonia in the greenhouse collection.
entries.zh: 植物学家对温室收藏的两种猴面包树属植物作了比较。

entries.en: The seminar's discussion of adaptationism ran well past the scheduled break time.
entries.zh: 研讨会上关于适应论的讨论持续了很久，早已过了预定的休息时间。

entries.en: The adaptationist challenged our claim that the trait had arisen by chance.
entries.zh: 那位适应主义者对我们关于该性状偶然形成的说法提出了质疑。

entries.en: The experiment compared the plants' adaptedness to two different soils.
entries.zh: 实验比较了那些植物对两种不同土壤的适应性。

entries.en: The team's adaptiveness kept the project moving when the venue changed.
entries.zh: 场地变动时，团队的适应能力使项目得以继续推进。

entries.en: We tested the controller's adaptivity under several changing input patterns.
entries.zh: 我们在几种不断变化的输入模式下，测试了控制器的自适应性。

entries.en: They disagreed about whether the extract should be classed as an adaptogen.
entries.zh: 他们对是否应把那种提取物归为适应原意见不一。

entries.en: The review separated studies of adaptogens from studies of ordinary dietary ingredients.
entries.zh: 那篇综述把适应原研究与普通膳食成分研究分开讨论。

entries.en: The dressmaker saved the last length of adarsa for the sleeves.
entries.zh: 裁缝把最后那段高级印度薄纱留着做袖子。

entries.en: Aday waited under the awning until the rain had eased.
entries.zh: 阿达伊在遮阳篷下等到雨势减弱。
